headline: Senior HR Business Partner | Strategic Talent Management & Operations
summary: Accomplished HR professional with over 11 years of experience in the Nepal corporate landscape, specializing in the transition from high-volume talent acquisition to strategic HR business partnering. Proven expertise in aligning human resources initiatives with business objectives at leading organizations like Daraz and CG Corp Global. Deeply familiar with Nepal Labor Act 2074 and Social Security Fund (SSF) regulations. Committed to fostering high-performance cultures through data-driven engagement and operational excellence.

experiences.title: HR Business Partner
description: Serve as a strategic partner to the Logistics and Commercial leadership teams, overseeing HR operations for 400+ employees.
Implemented a revamped performance management system using OKRs, leading to a 15% increase in departmental productivity metrics.
Navigate complex employee relations issues and grievances in compliance with the Nepal Labor Act 2074 and internal Alibaba global standards.
Lead organizational design initiatives to optimize headcount and workforce planning during peak e-commerce seasons like 11.11.
Drive employee engagement programs that resulted in a 20% improvement in annual Great Place to Work survey scores.

experiences.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Managed end-to-end recruitment for 12+ business units including FMCG, Electronics, and Hospitality sectors across Nepal.
Successfully transitioned into broader HR operations by assisting the HR Director in drafting the Group’s updated Employee Handbook and Policy Manual.
Reduced average cost-per-hire by 30% by building an internal talent pipeline and reducing reliance on external recruitment agencies.
Orchestrated large-scale campus recruitment drives at top-tier Nepali institutions like Kathmandu University and Tribhuvan University.
Supervised a team of three junior recruiters and handled executive search for C-suite positions within the conglomerate.

experiences.title: HR Generalist
description: Coordinated recruitment activities for the Technology and Customer Service departments, processing over 200 hires annually.
Administered monthly payroll processing and benefits administration for a workforce of 500+ permanent staff.
Facilitated onboarding and orientation programs for new hires, ensuring seamless integration into the Ncell corporate culture.
Maintained the HRIS database and generated weekly reports on turnover, headcount, and recruitment funnel health.

experiences.title: HR Intern
description: Assisted the HR department in screening resumes and scheduling interviews for the service center technical staff.
Updated employee personnel files and digitized physical records for the department’s transition to a new HRIS.
